Both orders delegate a long enumerated set of presidential functions to the Secretary of the Treasury using nearly identical introductory language, then preserve prior presidential actions and define “functions” and “perform” in the same terms. More distinctively, both address the Secretary’s vessel-control authority under the first paragraph of section 1 of Title II of the Act of June 15, 1917.
